metadata.title: COSU Lab Instrument Terminal SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Lab Instrument Terminals as constrained, high-integrity endpoint execution environments dedicated to scientific instrumentation.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated to the control, operation, or monitoring of laboratory instruments, with restricted functionality and tightly controlled data flows.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Lab Instrument Terminals inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint dedicated to laboratory instrumentation.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to vendor-supplied instrument control and monitoring software.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Access may be shared among authorized lab users via session-based or role-based controls.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Lab Instrument Terminals are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Endpoints are centrally managed, with documented exceptions for vendor-imposed constraints.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is established for integrity, management, and network trust, not user or data entitlement.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration restricts background services, removable media, unauthorized interfaces, and non-instrument software.

props.name: anti-tamper-controls
props.remarks: Controls protect against configuration drift, unauthorized software installation, and manipulation that could affect instrument operation or results.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is restricted to the instrument, required storage targets, management services, and explicitly approved research systems.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Local data persistence is permitted only as required for instrument operation and is governed by retention and transfer workflows.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Lab Instrument Terminals may participate only in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1 and 2 unless separately approved.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: High instrument integrity requirements do not imply eligibility for higher-classification institutional data.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Terminal integrity, availability, and critical state changes are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Provisioning, maintenance, reset, and retirement of Lab Instrument Terminals are documented and auditable under Secure Endpoint lifecycle governance.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Lab Instrument Terminals implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on stability, integrity of scientific operation, and constrained data flows.

roles.title: Laboratory Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for instrument availability, approved software use, and coordination with endpoint security.

roles.title: Endpoint Security Operations
roles.remarks: Ensures security posture, monitoring, and lifecycle governance for Lab Instrument Terminals.

control-implementation.remarks: Lab Instrument Terminal implementations are OS- and vendor-specific and are maintained as documented, exception-aware configuration baselines aligned with this SSPP.
